description:
## Metadata Text-Mining Workflow Description

The metadata text-mining workflow is a multi-phase workflow that extracts structured data from metadata sources such as OpenAgrar and BonaRes. The main phases of the workflow are:

1. Harvest metadata from OpenAgrar and BonaRes.
2. Convert harvested metadata into text files.
3. Perform automatic pre-annotation.
4. Manually annotate and curate in INCEpTION.
5. Transform curated exports into corpus artifacts and dataset splits.
6. Use splits for LLM evaluation and encoder-model training.

This is an abstract workflow description, that serves as a documentation of the overall workflow structure. It is a first step towards a fully executable workflow.
For a more detailed description of the workflow, refer to the `REPOSITORY_WORKFLOWS.md` file.
